I don’t have live web access, so I can’t fetch real-time headlines. I can either (A) give a concise summary of NVIDIA’s situation up to my last update (June 2024), (B) show how you can get the very latest headlines instantly (search queries, RSS/alerts, best sources), or (C) summarize any NVIDIA articles/links you paste here. Which would you like?

If you want option B (quick ways to get live news), here are practical, ready-to-use items:

1) One‑click sources to check right now
- NVIDIA Newsroom (press releases / product announcements) — https://nvidia.com
- Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, Wall Street Journal, Financial Times (business/markets)
- The Verge, TechCrunch, Ars Technica, The Register (tech/product coverage)
- SEC EDGAR (for official filings) and NVIDIA Investor Relations (earnings)

2) Google News / search queries you can paste
- Google News: NVIDIA
- Web search examples:
  - NVIDIA OR NVDA latest news
  - NVIDIA earnings OR revenue OR guidance
  - NVIDIA H100 OR Blackwell OR "AI chip" OR GPU
  - NVIDIA antitrust OR lawsuit OR "regulatory"  

3) Set up immediate alerts
- Google Alerts: create an alert for “NVIDIA OR NVDA” and set frequency to “As-it-happens.”
- Twitter/X: follow @NVIDIA, major reporters (e.g., tech/business columnists) and create a list for NVIDIA-related accounts/analysts.
- RSS: subscribe to NVIDIA newsroom + Reuters/Bloomberg/NYT feeds in an RSS reader (Feedly, Inoreader).

4) Stock / earnings quick checks
- Use Google Finance or Yahoo Finance for NVDA real‑time price, recent news, and filings links.
- Check latest 8‑K / 10‑Q/10‑K on SEC EDGAR for formal disclosures.

5) Want curated alerts for a specific angle?
- Say “product releases,” “earnings/financials,” “legal/regulatory,” “partnerships/acquisitions,” or “stock/market moves” and I’ll give tailored queries and the top sources to watch.

If you want a historical summary up to June 2024 or a quick digest of the last major themes I know, say so and I’ll provide that now. Or paste any link(s) and I’ll summarize.
